generation.explanation: This shows a scatter plot with the least-squares line of best fit. Drag any yellow point and the line refits right away, using slope = Σ(x−x̄)(y−ȳ) / Σ(x−x̄)². The line always passes through the mean point (x̄, ȳ), which is drawn in red.
